title: Spring flow shape trends were uncertain at three Arctic gauges in 31 certified years from 1980 to 2011
abstract: We tested time asymmetry in April-July discharge at Ob-Salekhard, Lena-Kyusyur and Yenisey-Igarka. We used 31 common complete certified years in ArcticGRO v20261104 from 1980 to 2011. The response was the later minus earlier spacing of cumulative-flow quartiles. Trends were +0.213, -0.036 and +0.368 days per decade. All three adjusted block-bootstrap limits included zero. An April-August Yenisey check was positive, but the estimate changed sign with a 1990 start. Thus these data did not establish a robust shape trend. This extends earlier timing and width tests with a different response on the same records. Short records, fixed windows, flow regulation and conditional uncertainty limit inference. Code, source hashes, aggregate results and an arithmetic audit support reproduction.

display.caption: Annual spring quartile-spacing difference and fitted trends. Limits use five-year residual blocks and adjustment for three main slopes.
